Dos signos de fuego: hay chispa inmediat: Two Fire signs: there is instant spark, enthusiasm, and a desire to live big. The risk is competing for the spotlight or arguing too intensely; if you learn to celebrate each other's wins, you are an unstoppable team.
Dos signos de tierra: comparten el gusto: Two Earth signs: you share a taste for the concrete, for stability, and for building patiently. You feel safe together, though you should make sure routine does not put out the play and the surprise.
Dos signos de aire: la conversación fluy: Two Air signs: conversation flows, you stimulate each other mentally, and you respect each other's space. What deserves watching is that so much talk does not push deeper emotions into the background.
Dos signos de agua: se entienden sin tan: Two Water signs: you understand each other without many words and there is great empathy. You need to make sure shared emotions do not amplify into collective sadness, and keep some practical anchor.
Fuego y aire: el aire aviva el fuego. Ha: Fire and Air: air fans the fire. There is constant stimulation, humor, plans, and movement; it is one of the most dynamic combinations, with the challenge of staying steady when the novelty fades.
Tierra y agua: la tierra da forma y cont: Earth and Water: earth gives water shape and containment, and water nourishes earth. It is a blend of care, tenderness, and home, ideal for building something lasting.
Fuego y tierra: uno impulsa y el otro es: Fire and Earth: one drives and the other steadies. You can complement each other beautifully if fire respects earth's timing and earth does not dampen the enthusiasm with too much caution.
Fuego y agua: pasión y sensibilidad en t: Fire and Water: passion and sensitivity in creative tension. When you understand each other there is depth and warmth; when you do not, one feels the other is too abrupt and the other too intense. It calls for a lot of communication.
Tierra y aire: la tierra aporta realismo: Earth and Air: earth brings realism and air brings ideas and perspective. You learn a lot from each other, though you may get exasperated when one wants firm plans and the other wants to keep exploring.
Aire y agua: la mente y el corazón busca: Air and Water: the mind and the heart looking for their common language. There is romance and curiosity if air listens to the emotions and water dares to put them into words.
Ambos son de modalidad cardinal: dos ini: Both are cardinal: two initiators. Ideas and starting energy abound; you need to agree on who leads in each area so you do not clash.
Ambos son de modalidad fija: dos persona: Both are fixed: two loyal, steadfast people. Your commitment is strong, but when you disagree neither gives in easily; learning to be flexible is key.
Ambos son de modalidad mutable: dos alma: Both are mutable: two adaptable souls. You adjust easily, but firm decisions may be missing, along with someone to hold the course.
Uno es cardinal y el otro fijo: uno prop: One is cardinal and the other fixed: one proposes and the other sustains. It works if the one who starts respects the depth of the one who consolidates.
Uno es cardinal y el otro mutable: uno m: One is cardinal and the other mutable: one sets the path and the other adapts. It goes well as long as adapting does not turn into giving up.
Uno es fijo y el otro mutable: la firmez: One is fixed and the other mutable: steadfastness meets flexibility. There is balance if the fixed one listens and the mutable one commits.
{a} con {b}: se reconocen como en un esp: {a} with {b}: you recognize each other as in a mirror. You instantly understand how the other thinks, but you also share the same blind spots, and what is not worked on in one is repeated in the other.
{a} y {b} son signos vecinos: parecidos: {a} and {b} are neighboring signs: close on the calendar and very different in style. Each sees in the other something they lack and sometimes something they cannot quite grasp. You work when you are curious about each other without trying to fix each other.
{a} y {b} forman un aspecto de sextil: s: {a} and {b} form a sextile: you get along naturally and boost each other with little effort. It is a friendship that can become a couple; the relationship grows when you bring intention and do not take it for granted.

{a} y {b} forman un trígono: es el aspec: {a} and {b} form a trine: it is the most harmonious aspect of the zodiac. Understanding, trust, and support flow. The challenge, paradoxically, is not to get complacent and to keep nurturing the relationship.
{a} y {b} están en quincuncio: no compar: {a} and {b} are in a quincunx: you share neither element nor modality, and almost nothing is obvious to the other. It is a relationship of constant learning that asks for adjustments and plenty of patience, but it can be deeply transformative.
{a} y {b} son signos opuestos: se atraen: {a} and {b} are opposite signs: you attract each other like poles that complete one another. Each has exactly what the other lacks, which creates magnetism and also friction. When you integrate, you form a complete circle.
Dos Aries se encienden al instante y com: Two Aries ignite instantly and compete over everything, even over who loves more. If they take turns leading and laugh at their clashes, they make a brave couple that never gets bored.
Aries llega con prisa y Tauro con calma,: Aries arrives in a hurry and Taurus takes it slow, and that is exactly where the lesson lies: Aries teaches daring and Taurus teaches savoring. They work when Aries respects the pace and Taurus dares to improvise.
Aries propone y Géminis comenta: hay jue: Aries proposes and Gemini comments: there is play, humor, and lots of conversation. The challenge is that Gemini changes the subject just when Aries wants to act; a short, concrete plan keeps them together.
Aries actúa antes de sentir y Cáncer sie: Aries acts before feeling and Cancer feels before acting. The union asks for tenderness from Aries and emotional courage from Cancer; if they manage it, they truly protect each other.
Dos fuegos que se admiran: Aries aporta: Two Fires who admire each other: Aries brings drive and Leo brings warmth and pride. It is a passionate, generous couple; the only thing to watch is that neither always wants to be the star.
Aries ve el panorama y Virgo ve los deta: Aries sees the big picture and Virgo sees the details. When Virgo organizes Aries energy and Aries shakes up Virgo routine, they complement each other; criticism, on the other hand, cools things quickly.
Son opuestos que se atraen: Aries va dir: They are opposites who attract: Aries goes straight ahead and Libra prefers to negotiate. They teach each other to be firm and to listen; the key is deciding together and not through turns of pride.
Dos signos regidos por Marte, con pasión: Two signs ruled by Mars, with intense passion. Aries is open and Scorpio is reserved: there is strong chemistry, and also jealousy or power struggles without honesty.
Fuego con fuego libre: aventura, risa y: Fire with free-spirited Fire: adventure, laughter, and a desire to explore. Both value frankness and freedom; they need to make sure the rush does not leave important topics unspoken.
Aries inicia y Capricornio construye. Ch: Aries starts and Capricorn builds. They clash over control, but if they admire each other for their strengths, they achieve big projects: Aries brings courage and Capricorn brings steadiness.
Aries es impulsivo y Acuario original: s: Aries is impulsive and Aquarius is original: they understand each other in their rejection of the conventional. It works if Aries respects Aquarius independence and Aquarius does not cool off in the face of Aries impetuousness.
Aries es directo y Piscis soñador. Aries: Aries is direct and Pisces is a dreamer. Aries protects and energizes, Pisces softens and inspires; they need to make sure blunt words do not hurt Pisces sensitivity.
Dos Tauro comparten gustos, estabilidad: Two Taurus share tastes, stability, and loyalty; their home is usually a refuge. The risk is mutual stubbornness and falling into routine, so it pays to plan surprises.
Tauro busca seguridad y Géminis variedad: Taurus seeks security and Gemini seeks variety. Gemini refreshes Taurus life and Taurus gives Gemini roots; without agreements on pace and routine, one feels tied down and the other insecure.

Dos signos de tierra prácticos que se en: Two practical Earth signs who understand each other without drama. Taurus brings calm and Virgo brings care for details; spontaneity is sometimes missing, which is solved with a new plan every so often.
Venus rige a ambos: ambos aman la bellez: Venus rules them both: both love beauty, affection, and good times. Taurus is firm and Libra is indecisive; negotiating with tenderness turns that difference into balance.
